title: Generate Professional Executive Headshots with Google Gemini
description: Your profile picture does more than fill a circle—it establishes authority and approachability. Master these refined prompt templates for Google Gemini to render natural, studio-lit headshots.

promptSet.title: Natural Outdoor Bokeh Professional Portrait
promptSet.prompt: Editorial portrait of a young professional in a navy blue casual sweater, standing outdoors in front of modern architecture with lush green foliage. Golden hour backlight, beautiful round optical bokeh, 85mm f/1.4 lens, natural skin tones, relaxed smile.
instructions: Paste the prompt and specify your desired background ambiance.
Download and set as your official profile picture.
promptSet.exampleOutput: Warm, golden-hour outdoor portrait with gorgeous circular bokeh and natural highlights.
